'''2015 San Diego Grand Prix Results Steve Harpster LS This Is Getting Out Of Hand''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2015 San Diego Grand Prix]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Harpster]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 San Diego Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open This Is Getting Out Of Hand Harpste.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-san-diego-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130400/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-san-diego-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]
